subject: Community Hoops
overview: Tufts University basketball players Mikayla Paquette and Callie O'Brien discussed Community Hoops, a nonprofit offering youth basketball clinics in Medford and community programs in South Africa. They highlighted efforts to make basketball training accessible to youth of all skill levels.

items.title: Guest Introductions and Local Dining
items.summary: Tufts basketball players Mikayla Paquette and Callie O'Brien introduced themselves and highlighted Semolina as their favorite Medford restaurant.

items.title: Community Hoops Mission and Structure
items.summary: Paquette and O'Brien outlined the two-part structure of Community Hoops, which operates Sunday youth skill development clinics at Tufts and youth engagement programs across three sites in Johannesburg, South Africa.

items.title: Program Accessibility, Clinics, and Upcoming Season
items.summary: The guests explained that clinics are open to youth of all skill levels via online signups, discussed using basketball to teach off-court life skills, and previewed their upcoming season for the Tufts basketball team.
